## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Scope

- [ ] The change stays within `docs/SCOPE.md`, or the scope change was discussed first.
- [ ] User scans, local paths, generated workspaces and unlicensed data are absent.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused regression tests were added or updated.
- [ ] The full test suite passes.
- [ ] The public-tree and model-manifest checks pass.
- [ ] UI changes were checked in the desktop window at 1280×720 and a larger desktop size.

## Evidence

List the exact commands, fixtures and results used to verify the change.
